main_text.head: IIII Thesis.

p.i: Superiorum calumniarum impietatem non solùm Pontificiorum ipsorum crudelitas, sed & Protestantium patientia redarguit atque refellit.

main_text.head: SECT. V.
main_text.p: Pontificii olim impietatis Protestantes insi-mulabant, quòd imaginem Crucifixi adora-re abhorrerent: simúlq; responsum ab eis tu-lerunt, nempe, Ipsos paratos esse Crucifixi veras vivásq; imagines fieri, cruciatus omnes sustinendo pro nomine JESU. Quod illi, ex Pontificiorum decretis morti priùs adjudicati, constanter felicitérque præstiterunt. Simile nunc responsum habeant; cùm millies mille Protestantium nullum genus tormentorum recusaverint pro fide Christi: quam quidem fidem plurimi etiam eorum sanguine suo ob-signárunt. Ut hi jam à vobis Solifidiani & bonorum operum omnium hostes audiant? Proh hominum fidem frontémque!

page.notes: The running head left word is read as "Sect. v." (possibly "Sect. y."). The thesis statement and section heading are set in bold italic and spaced capitals; the thesis label is treated as a level 2 heading. Faint show-through text from the reverse side is omitted.
